subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep #41372 open as a broad routing umbrella, split the remaining slices into canonical owner-scoped issues, or close it after linking #85695 and #55792 as the active follow-ups?
rationale: The report spans stable runtime, channel, CLI, setup, and resource surfaces, and current main only proves partial fixes; deciding whether the umbrella remains useful is a maintainer workflow choice rather than a code-only judgment.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, use #85695 and #55792 for the strongest remaining config and Discord work, then close #41372 after every slice has a durable home.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave #41372 open as the broad field-report tracker until all referenced slices are fixed or explicitly rejected, accepting that it remains hard to automate or validate.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close #41372 now with links to #85695 and #55792, accepting that weaker web-search, update, and resource-pressure slices may need new issues if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, use #85695 and #55792 for the strongest remaining config and Discord work, then close #41372 after every slice has a durable home.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main evidence and sampled blame run through gateway config, CLI, docs, and onboard surfaces central to deciding how to retire or split the umbrella.
